about_short_description.short_description: Mineflow is an AI platform for predicting mineral deposit shapes and locations, helping mining companies from exploration to feasibility.

product.name: Mineflow AI Mineral Exploration Platform
product.description: An AI platform that predicts mineral deposit shapes and locations using geological data to support mining exploration and feasibility studies.

identifier.value: Automated Data Ingestion and Processing System

product.name: Automated Data Ingestion and Processing System
product.description: A system that automatically reads and extracts georeferenced data from hundreds of file formats without manual intervention, organizing exploration data for analysis.

product.name: 3D Drill Data Visualization Tools
product.description: Tools for creating interactive 3D visualizations and cross sections of drill hole data to analyze subsurface geology and mineralization patterns.

identifier.value: Mineflow Estimator Models and Export Capabilities

product.name: Mineflow Estimator Models and Export Capabilities
product.description: A suite of geostatistical models and data export functions that support site predictions and integration with major geological modeling software.
